summary: Executed backend pytest regression for expanded ecosystem and frontend Playwright flows on public URL. Backend expansion APIs passed; frontend exposed two critical UI defects (Certificates runtime crash and mobile nav horizontal overflow).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash: ReferenceError 'Button is not defined' in Certificates component causes page failure and blocks certificate cards/rendering.
Horizontal overflow on 390x844 viewport; nav links exceed viewport width.

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly creates certificate (API /api/certificates returns count=1), but frontend certificate page crashes and cannot display/download in UI.

issues: Responsive navigation still causes horizontal scrolling (document scrollWidth 450 on width 390).

action_items: Fix Certificates.jsx runtime error by importing/using Button correctly; retest certificate render/download from UI.
Refactor mobile nav layout to prevent horizontal overflow at 390px width and retest all added routes.
After fixes, rerun full student flow (class complete -> certificates -> download) and responsive navigation checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Certificates.jsx references <Button> without importing it, causing a production-breaking runtime error.
Responsive nav still overflows on mobile despite route expansion; layout does not contain link set within viewport.
Auth testing guideline file /app/auth_testing.md is missing from workspace path despite being referenced in instructions.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; created test support tickets and class attendance/certificate records via UI/API interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend expansion endpoints are stable (7/7 pytest pass). Reproduced certificate issue twice: /api/certificates returns data but /certificates UI crashes with 'Button is not defined'. Admin dashboard/support inbox works and ticket status updates are clickable. Persistence validated via API and UI for learning plan/tickets/attendance/messages, but certificate UI verification blocked by runtime crash.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Certificates failure: Repro steps -> login student -> complete class (/classes/lc-orientation) -> navigate /certificates. Browser shows uncaught runtime error 'ReferenceError: Button is not defined' from Certificates component; page content fails. API check in browser context confirms /api/certificates status 200 with certificate count 1, so backend is healthy and fault is frontend import/runtime. RCA-2 Mobile overflow: At viewport 390x844, top navigation/document scrollWidth exceeds innerWidth (450 > 390), producing horizontal scrolling due to accumulated nav link width.
